layout: A period selector (segmented: week / month / year), a headline number with its change, one main chart, then a breakdown list of the categories behind the number.

required: Headline number with change vs previous period

primaryAction.note: Reading is the action; no filled button unless the brief asks for one.

avoid: Several charts of the same data
Charts without axis labels or values
Numbers that disagree with the list

variants.layout: Chart first: period segmented control, headline number, one large chart, breakdown list.
Cards grid: headline number, then a 2x2 grid of metric cards with small sparklines, then the breakdown list.
Ranked: headline number with change, then the breakdown as horizontal bars ranked largest first, chart smaller below.
